caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an old-fashioned flat iron, centered on a plain, light-beige background. The iron is rendered in shades of brown, bronze, and dark gray, with subtle highlights and shadows suggesting a metallic surface with varying texture. The base of the iron is triangular with slightly rounded edges, and the surface shows some gradation in color indicating worn areas. The handle is ornate and curved, attached to the body at both ends, and features decorative details, including rounded joints and carved patterns. The drawing is highly detailed, with careful shading to indicate the three-dimensional form of the object. No other objects or background details are present in the composition; the flat iron is the sole focus of the artwork.
title: Iron
